title: Gandonio
description: You came to Gandonio without respect.
body:
Replaces the standard Totem of Undying with a unique artifact belonging to Gandonio - a mysterious and incredibly “lucky” character who, according to legend, always manages to escape the most hopeless situations.

When a fatal blow is about to strike you, Gandonio takes control and gives you a second chance. Now you won’t just revive - you’ll come back in style, holding his legendary totem!
